name: Improvado
description: Improvado is a marketing data platform offering a free public plain-text ask endpoint for AI agents.

flows.description: An agent sends one plain-text question about marketing data architecture, connectors, pipelines, attribution, or MCP design and receives a cited plain-text answer.
constraints: never send credentials, personal data, or private customer data

facts.description: Canonical, on-site-verifiable facts about Improvado. Each value cites the page it was verified against.

whatItIs.value: A marketing data platform that extracts, transforms, governs, and analyzes marketing data for enterprises and agencies.

pricingModel.value: Free Limited ($0/mo) and MCP Only ($100/mo) self-serve; Advanced and Enterprise custom, quote-based.
